issue:
Implement the real REDLINE local HTML report renderer in render_analysis.py. Keep the public interfaces render_report(analysis: dict) -> str and main(argv=None) -> int. render_report accepts only schema redline-upper-analysis/v1. Required top-level fields: nonempty string source_model, list of string evidence_ids, and model_analysis object with nonempty summary string, findings list, and nonempty limitations list of nonempty strings. Each finding requires evidence_ids (nonempty list of IDs present in top-level evidence_ids), nonempty assessment and recommendation strings. Reject missing/wrong fields, bad types, unknown schema and invented evidence with ValueError. An empty findings list is valid and must include the fixed visible body text 安全判定は未実施. Do not turn absence of findings into a safety or independent-verification claim. Do not mutate any part of the input.
Return standalone HTML5, beginning with <!DOCTYPE html>, html lang="ja", UTF-8 meta charset, a title, head and body; output <=256000 UTF-8 bytes. Use Japanese section headings containing 概要, 指摘, 証拠, モデル, 制約. Display summary, EVERY finding assessment/recommendation/evidence reference, all top-level evidence IDs, source_model and EVERY limitation as visible text inside body. Inputs may contain multiple independent findings and multiple limitations: never render only the first item. Text only in title/head, comments or attributes does not count as visible report content. Render only these selected fields, never raw generation_attempts/client receipts. Escape all untrusted text, including model names and evidence IDs, so supplied script/img/iframe/SVG snippets appear only as visible literal text and never become markup/attributes. No JavaScript, external resources, hyperlinks, networking, forms, event handlers, meta refresh or dynamic execution. CSS is forbidden entirely: no style element, style attribute, CSS escapes, url() or @import. The ONLY attributes allowed anywhere are lang on html and charset on meta; use html lang="ja" and meta charset="UTF-8". Reject duplicate attributes. No hidden, class, id, background, src, href, srcdoc or other attributes. Use ordinary passive HTML headings/lists/tables/paragraphs with no attributes. Do not invent a claim that the target is safe or independently verified.
CLI: python render_analysis.py --input ANALYSIS_JSON --out FRESH_HTML. Read UTF-8 JSON and write UTF-8 HTML. Support spaces and Japanese file paths. Return 0 on success and nonzero on malformed/invalid input or existing output. Never overwrite existing output or the input itself, and do not create a successful report for invalid input. Only Python standard library; allowed imports are argparse, html, json, pathlib, re, sys, typing, collections and copy (plus __future__). No eval/exec/compile/__import__ or subprocess. Only modify render_analysis.py; preserve tests and task files.
